summary: This clinical study compares two treatments, the drug SHR-3167 and Insulin Degludec, in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus. Type 2 diabetes mellitus is a condition where the body does not use insulin properly to control blood sugar. Participants in the study are already treated with basal insulin, which is a long-acting type of insulin used to maintain steady blood sugar levels. The trial aims to look at how well these treatments help manage blood sugar levels.
